title: Fractionation of humic acid and its effects on the photodegradation of amitriptyline in water
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,2730-2739
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00228A, Paper
Li Zhiwen, Liu Hui, Li Tie, Ou Xiaoxia, Wang Kaixuan, Sun Bing
HA was fractionated on a silica gel column to get three fractions, i.e. FA, FB and FC, according to the polarity. HA fractions generated reactive halogen species in the presence of halides and promoted the photodegradation of amitriptyline.
